glyphs.name: Ceres
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (1) Ceres; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: Open crook above a lower cross.
glyphs.design_note: Keep the upper hook open and distinguish the crook from Saturn's lower hook.

glyphs.name: Pallas
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (2) Pallas; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: Open diamond above a lower cross.
glyphs.design_note: The diamond counter stays large; round joins belong to the existing Moira family.

glyphs.name: Juno
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (3) Juno; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: Eight-rayed head above a lower cross.
glyphs.design_note: Eight rays distinguish Juno from the six-ray sextile. The 56-unit optical stroke gives the center more space.

glyphs.name: Vesta
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (4) Vesta; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: Detached flame stroke above two open, winged downward chevrons.
glyphs.design_note: Preserve the angular flame/altar construction of the U+26B6 form. The historical U+1F777 form remains a separate future alternate.

glyphs.name: Chiron
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (2060) Chiron; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: K-like key head rising from an open oval.
glyphs.design_note: Separate the arms from the base loop; keep the right branch open and the oval legible.

glyphs.name: Pholus
glyphs.meaning: Physical numbered small body (5145) Pholus; identity is separate from any similarly named lot, moon or hypothetical point.
glyphs.form: P-like head rising from an open oval.
glyphs.design_note: Two open counters distinguish this form. The lower oval and tall stem align with Chiron, while the closed head remains distinct.

glyphs.name: Semisextile
glyphs.meaning: Zodiacal aspect with exact native nominal angle 30 degrees; orb and motion policy remain outside the font.
glyphs.form: Open upward arms meeting a horizontal baseline.
glyphs.design_note: Keep this exact vertical reflection relationship with quincunx; do not rotate the glyph in text.

glyphs.name: Semisquare
glyphs.meaning: Zodiacal aspect with exact native nominal angle 45 degrees; orb and motion policy remain outside the font.
glyphs.form: Open angle: diagonal meeting a horizontal baseline.
glyphs.design_note: U+2220 retains its ANGLE identity. Its semisquare use is contextual and annotated by Unicode.

glyphs.name: Sesquiquadrate
glyphs.meaning: Zodiacal aspect with exact native nominal angle 135 degrees; orb and motion policy remain outside the font.
glyphs.form: Open square with an attached lower-right elbow.
glyphs.design_note: Use the square/elbow structure of the assigned U+26BC reference form. Retain a large square counter and a clear projecting elbow.

glyphs.name: Quincunx
glyphs.meaning: Zodiacal aspect with exact native nominal angle 150 degrees; orb and motion policy remain outside the font.
glyphs.form: Horizontal cap with open downward arms.
glyphs.design_note: A vertical reflection of semisextile, with the cap explicitly at the top.
